property.description: PDM clock and rising-edge input channel. EK-RA8P1 microphones use input 2. Stereo is supported on input 0 only and requires its own pin route.
Signed 20-bit PCM in int32_t. A mono frame is one sample; a stereo frame is rising then falling samples.

Use the microphone datasheet wake-up time. Driver adds 4 ms for its fixed filter settling. Requires running 8 MHz MOCO/PDMIFCLK and PCLKB in 1..100 MHz. Fixed 2 MHz PDM clock, sinc M=125, half-band /2: 8000 frames/s nominal.
Called in IRQ context on completion, overflow or error. NULL uses status polling for completion of interrupt-driven capture. Cross-security callbacks are unsupported.
